notes.title: TankYou! Patch 1.0.2
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/4nJSePP.gif[/img]

This second patch targets a general quality of life improvement for the game, aiming to simplify the way you play, from many points of view, from UI, to gameplay mechanics, to visuals. It also paves the way for the upcoming 1st major update for the game.

Here's the list of changes:

[b]User Interface[/b]
Enhanced the tips messages on the defeat screen to help when fighting boss type enemies
Boss enemy health bars now change color when taking damage
Added objective text when playing
Added text effects for objectives when starting a game
Added main menu hints for unlocks
Added version identifier on the main menu screen

[b]Gameplay[/b]
Tank cabin rotation now remains independent of the tank rotation
Tank backwards movement speed increased
Reduced homing missile area of effect damage
Increased tank speed when sliding against the map borders
No longer get prop damage when speed powerup coin level2 is on
No longer get damage or slowdown from props when speed powerup coin level3 is on
Parachuting powerup crates no longer get destroyed so easily

[b]Controls[/b]
Further improved mouse aiming support
Mouse buttons can now be used as A,B in all menus

[b]In game visuals[/b]
Picking up powerups now bring up text tags over the player tank to better help identify that powerup, it's effect and level
Improved the infiltration caught effect
Added enemy exclamation graphics mark when in pursuit for players
Added color animations to the tank HUD when picking up, upgrading or using weapons
Improved Sniper Scope powerups visuals and audio
Improved Reflective Shield Visual Effect
Added level 2 and level 3 speed powerup effects
Changed map border colors to red, in city/country environments

[b]Bugs Fixes[/b]
Fixed main menu arrows sometimes losing their position
Fixed main menu 2d UI staying hidden after leaving the options menu
Fixed a secret typo in the tutorial screen has been fixed :)
Fixed gamescreen objective text bounds for "score" type missions
Fixed a bug where shield Lv3 would stay on you until death
Fixed a bug where aerial missiles could kill you while your shield lv2 or lv3 is on
Fixed lasers passing through walls

notes.title: TankYou! Patch 1.0.1
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/0vYEKaI.gif[/img]

A day 2 patch has been loaded today. TankYou! v1.01 is addressing some issues affecting the game experience. They are not many, but important. And a nice little feature to make you feel better when losing. Here's the list:

[b]Improved mouse aiming algorithm[/b]
- there is now a new method for calculating turret rotation, based on the direction and also speed at which the mouse moves. It is now possible to softly aim your turret when playing with a mouse, for maximum accuracy.
[b]Added Mouse sensitivity in Options Menu[/b]
- to improve keyboard/mouse support, there is now a "mouse sensitivity" option
[b]Coins now have a higher chance of spawning when the score condition is to get coins[/b]
- this should now reduce the time spent in "Gold Digger" mode and Arcade missions where you need to gather coins in order to score
[b]Improved the camera follow algorithm[/b]
- the camera now accurately detects the center of players instead of calculating their overall positional weight
[b]Tips messages[/b]
- a small feature to help you deal with defeat when playing alone or Arcade modes
[b]Walls behave correctly when shot[/b]
- some walls behaved incorrectly when show with rockets

For any suggestions or inconveniences feel free to use the forums. Unless you're really happy and want to post a positive review, which is totally fine.

notes.title: TANKYOU! is now officially released!
notes.content:
[img]http://i.imgur.com/9Ypg0jt.gif[/img]

It's been a long ride, but the tanks can now finally drop in, worldwide.

First off, I cannot thank everyone enough, who have supported TankYou! since the original Steam Greenlight campaign. And on this note, I'd like to say that I did my best to step over the initial promise and offer even more maps, bosses, game modes and a general higher quality of life and quality for the game. It's gotten here thanks to your support, no other way! And there will be more!

What happens now is, the tides of the release day need to clear, after which, the roadmap goes onward. Yes! There is still content heading TankYou!'s way, as a game is never really finished, especially TankYou! which I hope to become "the game" to play when your friends are over. More precisely, there are 5 free, planned updates on the way, to add to the craziness. Expect more of everything!

The TankYou! Soundtrack DLC is the only DLC the game will be getting for the foreseeable future. It stands as appreciation to the amazing work composer Andrew Brady has put in. If you'd like to show support, then this DLC is the answer.

For answers, questions or if you'd just like to say "hi!", come to the game's official forum, here on steam, don't be shy. It's the place to follow future updates as well.

In the meantime, have fun breaking and blowing stuff up!
